title: Restaurant Marketing Automation: AI Campaigns | Bloom Intelligence

facts.fact: Bloom's vendor-reported platform-wide count is 847 active campaigns and 1,000+ locations.
Bloom reports an average at-risk guest recovery rate of 38% across its 1,000+ restaurant locations.
Bloom reports a platform-wide average of $53K+ in revenue recovered per location per year in year one.
Bloom reports a 43% increase in guest lifetime value, which it says is verified by closed-loop POS attribution.
Bloom's page shows a 4.9 rating on Google, marked as verified.
Bloom's page shows a 4.6 rating on G2, marked as verified.
Bloom's customer Corky's Kitchen is listed with more than 60,000 guest profiles.
Bloom's customer Beachside Hospitality is listed as saving 15–20 hours per week.
Bloom states it detects at-risk guests 30–60 days early and reports a 38% average recovery.
facts.quote: Bloom detects at-risk guests 30–60 days early. 38% average recovery.

facts.fact: Bloom states it unifies 22+ data sources into guest profiles.
facts.quote: Bloom unifies 22+ data sources into living guest profiles, automatically.

facts.fact: Bloom's illustrative example assumes a regular who visits twice a month at $45 loses over $1,000 per year.
facts.quote: One loyal regular visits twice a month at $45: that's over $1,000 per year slipping away, one guest at a time.

facts.fact: Bloom's illustrative calculation for a guest visiting twice a month at $45 per visit is $1,080 per year.
facts.quote: That's **$1,080 per year per guest, silently walking out**

facts.fact: In Bloom's sample guest profile, revenue attribution is tracked to a POS transaction within a 21-day window.
facts.quote: Tracked to POS transaction within 21-day window

facts.fact: Bloom's page states its offering is for qualified restaurant chains and requires no commitment.
facts.quote: For qualified restaurant chains · No commitment required
